body: with much trial and error, I was able to patchelf my way to get it working with loading the dynamic library, but that's not really a permanent solution. Somehow I need to get cargo to link vulkan correctly...
What was the patch that you needed to make?
I ran `patchelf --add-needed /nix/store/mi44faayr5padcm331wcc4rmqa3bj9pg-vulkan-loader-1.2.162.0/lib/libvulkan.so.1.2.162 target/debug/libbevy_dylib.so` so that bevy was able to link with vulkan.
Also, I've been using the lld linker for even faster iteration times (<1s) but lld doesn't link most of the libraries correctly to `/nix/store` so those also have to be patchelf'd manually.
https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/issues/24744 seems to be related to your lld issue. I think it has a way to support it, but I am not familiar with nix, so I can't say for sure.

> [NixOS/nixpkgs#24744](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/issues/24744) seems to be related to your lld issue. I think it has a way to support it, but I am not familiar with nix, so I can't say for sure.

Oh, thanks! That fixed my problem with lld not finding libraries, however vulkan-loader still needs to be linked manually...
Having precisely this issue with linking vulkan-loader as well.

Using the `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` export documented in the [Nix/NixOS](https://github.com/amethyst/amethyst#nixnixos) section of amethyst doc solves it for me when using the dev shell. I haven't tested building a package yet though.

Here's the flake I use : https://github.com/mdevlamynck/nix-flake-templates/blob/master/bevy/flake.nix

(btw @zyansheep, you can use the `self` input (like `defaultPackage = self.packages."${system}".ray_game;`) to refer to your flake output without needing to use `rec { … }`.)

Having just gotten Bevy running on a NixOS host via a Nix Flake with the help of @mdevlamynck 's example (thank you!), I just wanted to share the reasons why things *weren't* working for me, in case it's helpful to anyone else:

* Initially I was using `nixpkgs.url = "github:nixos/nixpkgs/nixos-21.05";` as per @mdevlamynck 's `flake.nix`, but my host is running on the unstable channel, which appears to have been causing linking issues with vulkan at runtime. Switching that to `nixpkgs.url = "github:nixos/nixpkgs/nixpkgs-unstable";` appears to have fixed it. It seems counterproductive to need my flake's nixpkgs version to match my host, so if anyone knows what's going on there, I'd be interested to know.
* The first time I fixed the above, I didn't do a `cargo clean`, so I was still running build artifacts from the previous environment. Doing a full rebuild with every change to `flake.nix` helped narrow things down properly.

Other things to note:

* I was getting errors when trying to run `vkcube` in my `nix develop .` shell, which was leading me to believe that vulkan wasn't working at all within the shell. Turns out this is also do to with my host environment conflicting somehow, since if I open the shell with `nix develop . -i -k DISPLAY -k HOME` (clearing all my host env vars except for `DISPLAY` and `HOME`), `vkcube` runs fine.
* I don't appear to need the `build.rs` file described [on the wiki section for NixOS](https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/main/docs/linux_dependencies.md).

For reference, [here's the `flake.nix`](https://gist.github.com/polendri/f1cd3d5e3d3375b1125c2a9f27c5a1bb) I've been using.
